blocks.title: Benchmarks
blocks.lead: What we tested on Teleion Fabric, how well it performed, and what tradeoffs matter. Setup details, confidence intervals, adapter comparisons, and summary records live on one technical page: [See how we measured this →](/benchmarks/methodology/).

entries.label: correct structured answers across 60 recall and 60 request-splitting tests with zero context-shim tokens (separate 2x T4 memory adapter vs 222-token text shim; 2.28x lower amortized batch generation time). 76 of the 120 baseline replies hit the fixed token budget, and recall alone was not significant (41 vs 35 of 60), so most of the gain is on request splitting and within the budget
